title: Full Stack Developer
description:
What if your next role would let you shape user experiences at the core of Finlands financial infrastructure?

Were looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our New Business -team in Euroclear Finlands IT department for a permanent position.

This position suits a developer who values engineering excellence, meaningful impact, and professional autonomy, and who enjoys solving complex problems in a stable but continuously evolving environment contributing to systems that are critical to the Finnish and Nordic financial markets.

Your responsibilities

In this role, youll build and operate modern, long-lived systems where quality, reliability, and security are critical. Working closely with other developers, architects, product owners, and UX designers, youll deliver secure and scalable full-stack solutions, from user interfaces to backend services and deployment pipelines. Your work will support business-critical systems used daily by key market participants in a highly regulated financial environment.

In this role you will

Design and build modern user interfaces with focus on usability, accessibility, performance

Design and develop full stack software that fulfils functional and non-functional requirements.

Implement necessary APIs, integrations, data flows.

Take ownership of end-to-end delivery (design -> build -> test -> deploy -> operate)

Develop and maintain automated tests

Ensure performance, security, and reliability of solutions

Work with container platforms and Linux-based runtime environments both on-premises and in cloud.

Apply engineering best practices (maintainable code, reviews, CI/CD, documentation)

Collaborate with product, UX, architecture and development teams

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a generalist software developer with a strong front-end mindset, who combines technical skills with a genuine interest in user experience and quality delivery.

- At least 5 years of hands-on experience in front-end development (React, TypeScript)
- Proven ability to build high-quality, user-centric interfaces in collaboration with UX/service designer
- Solid backend development skills (Java / Spring Boot)
- Knowledge of secure software development practices
- Experience with APIs and integrations
- Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright (or similar)
- Understanding of testing strategies and quality engineering
- Experience with containers and Linux runtime environments
- Strong problem-solving skills and an ownership-driven approach
- Good communication skills and fluency in English. Our working language is English. Fluency in Finnish is considered an advantage.
- Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams.

Nice to have

- Experience in financial or regulated environment
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (e.g. Azure)

We are open to different experience levels and value both strong hands-on expertise and a growth mindset. While this role offers support and collaboration, it requires enough practical experience to work independently and take ownership for your own deliverables from an early stage.

Why join us

Join Euroclear and play a key role at the very heart of the global, Nordic, and Finnish financial markets. As a trusted backbone connecting over 2,000 financial institutions worldwide, Euroclear safeguards the stability of the worlds capital markets, while our Helsinki office anchors critical infrastructure for Finlands financial system.

Despite our global reach, Euroclear Finland is a close-knit, local team where everyone quickly gets to know each other. Here, your ideas matter and your initiatives are valued by supportive leadership. We take pride in running the financial world safely and reliably, but above all, we are people working for people, valuing care, collaboration, and integrity every day.

What We Offer

Meaningful work with real impact

Build secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions that support critical market infrastructure.

Stability and modernisation

Work on business-critical systems while contributing to modern technologies and continuous development.

Strong tech community

Collaborate with experienced architects, developers, and domain experts who value quality and continuous improvement.

Modern ways of working

Enjoy a well-equipped Ruoholahti office, a hybrid model (3 days on-site, 2 remote), and a culture that supports learning and collaboration.

Wellbeing and benefits

We offer regular office breakfasts, a paid volunteering day, comprehensive occupational healthcare, and flexible wellbeing benefits covering sports, culture, transport, massage, dental care, and lunch.

How to apply

Ready to take the next step in your career?

Please submit your application, CV, and salary request directly to our Careers database by 14 September 2026. You may also include a link to your GitHub profile. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on a rolling basis.

For further inquiries, please contact our recruitment partner Arja Martikainen, Barona arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi.

Start date is negotiable but preferably in October 2026.

About Euroclear Finland

Euroclear group is a global provider of Financial Market Infrastructure (FMI) services.At the core, the group provides settlement, safe-keeping and servicing of domestic and cross-border securities for bonds, equities and derivatives to investment funds. The Euroclear group has multi-lingual, highly trained teams of professionals based in Europe, Asia, the Middle East and the Americas. The Euroclear group has +2 400 clients globally, settled the equivalent of EUR 1 072 trillion in securities transactions in 2023, representing 299 million domestic and cross-border transactions and held an average of EUR 37.7 trillion in assets for clients.

For more information about Euroclear Finland, please visit www.euroclear.fi or visit our group site www.euroclear.com

title: Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator (Levi)
description:
Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator
Levi, Lapland, Scandinavian Travel Group

We are looking for a reliable, energetic and hands-on Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator to join our team in Levi for the winter season 2026–2027.
This role supports the smooth daily flow of our winter operations. You will keep guest clothing and equipment clean, dry and ready for departures, assist guests with outfitting, and help maintain a clean and organized office environment.

WORK LOCATION & CONDITIONS
- Location: Scandinavian Travel Group office, Keskuskuja 2 B, Levi
- Working mode: Full-time, on-site
- Main office language: English
- Contract period: fixed-term employment 01.11.2026–31.03.2027
- Application deadline: 31.07.2026

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Winter clothing and gear management
-Cleaning, drying, disinfecting, sorting and organizing winter clothing and equipment
-Preparing correct sizes and clothing sets for guest departures
-Checking the condition of overalls, boots, helmets and other equipment
-Handling basic replacements, repairs and maintenance needs
-Keeping simple washing and maintenance records
2.Guest outfitting
-Helping guests dress and undress before and after activities
-Selecting correct sizes for overalls, boots, helmets and other gear
-Advising guests on layering and staying warm in Arctic conditions
-Providing friendly, efficient and practical customer service during busy departure times
3.Office housekeeping
-Keeping the kitchen, staff areas, front desk zone and entrance clean, safe and organized
-Supporting daily cleanliness in customer-facing and staff areas
-Maintaining a tidy and professional working environment throughout the day

REQUIREMENTS
-Good English skills are required.
-Valid Category B drivers license (minimum) and good driving experience are required.
-Previous cleaning, housekeeping, laundry or equipment maintenance experience is an advantage.
-Additional languages such as Spanish, French, German or Dutch are considered an advantage.

IDEAL PROFILE
-You are practical, reliable, positive and self-disciplined. You are physically ready for active work during a busy winter season, attentive to cleanliness and details, and comfortable working with international guests and colleagues.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Contract type
This is a fixed-term seasonal employment contract. The fixed-term nature is justified by the seasonal peak of the winter travel business in Lapland.

Salary and working hours
Contract type: fixed monthly salary
Starting monthly salary: €2,560 gross
Included working hours: average 37.5–40 hours per week

Supplements
Sunday and official public holiday work is compensated with a 100% pay increase according to Finnish law.
Evening and night work is compensated according to the applicable Program Services Sector Collective

Agreement (Ohjelmapalvelualan TES).
Working time averaging
Due to the seasonal nature of our work, we use a working time averaging arrangement under Finnish law and the applicable collective agreement. Working hours are averaged over the contract period. A work schedule is prepared in advance for each period.

WHAT WE PROVIDE
- Accommodation: a private room in the Levi area can be provided. Rent is €400 per person per month + electricity, under a separate fixed calendar-month lease agreement.
- Work clothing: warm workwear and necessary protective equipment are provided.
- Training: practical onboarding and work-specific training before and during the season.
- Transport: company cars may be used for transport from accommodation to the Levi office according to schedule and availability.
- Connectivity: work phone with a Finnish SIM may be provided depending on work needs.
- Insurance paid by the company: mandatory accident insurance during work, additional free-time accident insurance and additional health insurance.

ADDITIONAL PERKS
- Access to a shared seasonal ski pass for Levi slopes
- Possibility of local Levi fitness club membership
- Local worker discounts at selected restaurants and shops via Levi Passi
- Friendly international team and lively winter season atmosphere

HOW TO APPLY
Please send your CV and additional information in English to hr@gostg.fi.
Subject line: Winter Clothing & Office Housekeeping Coordinator — Levi
Please mention your earliest possible start date, relevant experience, language skills and whether you need accommodation in Levi.
Application deadline: 31.07.2026.

title: S-Päällikkö-valmennus, Varsinais-Suomi, Turun Osuuskauppa
description:
Primary location:
TURKU

Kasva päälliköksi ihan tavallisissa töissä – epätavallisen hyvässä porukassa!
Haluaisitko rakentaa uran kaupan tai ravintola-alan esihenkilönä – sellaisessa työssä, jossa arki on sopivasti vauhdikasta, ihmiset ovat keskiössä ja pääset oppimaan tekemällä?

Haemme nyt viittä S-Päällikkö-valmennettavaa kasvamaan tulosvastuullisiksi päälliköiksi Turun Osuuskauppaan. Valmennettavat työllistyvät kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, ja noin puolentoista vuoden mittainen valmennus alkaa 24.11.2026. Valmennuksen aikana saat vahvat valmiudet esihenkilötehtäviin sekä liiketoiminnan ja ihan tavallisen arjen johtamiseen.

Tässä haussa kaupan alan tehtävät sijoittuvat market-toimialalle eli Saleihin, S-marketeihin ja Prismoihin. Ravintola-alalla haemme valmennettavia ensisijaisesti nopean syömisen yksiköihin, kuten lounaskahviloihin ja Hesburgereihin.

Mitä S-Päällikkö-valmennus sisältää?

S-Päällikkö-valmennus yhdistää käytännön työssäoppimisen ja liiketoimintaosaamisen kehittämisen. Valmennuksen aikana työskentelet Turun Osuuskaupan eri yksiköissä Varsinais-Suomen alueella ja pääset tutustumaan toimialasi arkeen ihan käytännössä. Valmennus edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa sekä arkisin että viikonloppuisin toimipaikkojen työvuorojen mukaisesti. Meillä päälliköt eivät johda vain toimistosta käsin, vaan ovat mukana siellä missä tapahtuu: asiakkaiden, tuotteiden, annosten, tiimin ja päivän pienten säätöjen keskellä.

Työssäoppimisen aikana pääset palvelemaan asiakkaita, kehittämään yksikön toimintaa, huolehtimaan myyntikuntoisuudesta sekä osallistumaan liiketoiminnan päivittäiseen johtamiseen. Välillä on rauhallisempaa, välillä päivät ovat vauhdikkaita, mutta juuri siinä tavallisessa arjessa opitaan, miten hyvä työpäivä, toimiva tiimi ja tuloksellinen liiketoiminta rakennetaan.

Valmennus suunnitellaan yksilöllisesti aiemman kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella. Jokaiselle valmennettavalle nimetään henkilökohtainen tuutori, joka toimii esihenkilönäsi, tukee oppimistasi ja auttaa rakentamaan juuri sinulle sopivan kehittymispolun.

Valmennus toteutetaan yhteistyössä Jollas Instituutin kanssa. Käytännön työn lisäksi osallistut lähijaksoille yhdessä muiden alueosuuskauppojen valmennettavien kanssa, suoritat verkko-opintoja ja oppimistehtäviä sekä toteutat projektityön. Näin saat monipuolisen näkemyksen niin omasta toimialastasi kuin koko S-ryhmän liiketoiminnasta.

Valmennuksen hyödyt valmennettaville
Saat kokonaisvaltaisen käsityksen toimialasi liiketoiminnasta ja opit katsomaan arkea myös lukujen, tavoitteiden ja toimintaympäristön kautta.

Pääset työssäoppimisjaksojen kautta kehittämään yksiköiden ja henkilöstön toimintaa ihan oikeassa arjessa.

Ymmärrät esihenkilötyön kokonaiskuvan ja saat valmiudet toimia esihenkilöroolissa Turun Osuuskaupassa.

Verkostoidut S-ryhmän ammattilaisten kanssa ja saat hyvän käsityksen S-ryhmän liiketoimintakokonaisuudesta.


Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työsuhteen, Suomen monipuolisimmat henkilöstöedut, ePassi-edun sekä mahdollisuuden henkilöstörahastoon. Tehtävän palkkaus on 2552 € kuukaudessa. Lisäksi kuulut tulospalkitsemisen piiriin, joka antaa mahdollisuuden ansaita lisäpalkkiota tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta. Ihan tavallisia töitä siis – mutta epätavallisen hyvillä eduilla ja mahdollisuuksilla kasvaa.

Millaisia valmennettavia etsimme?

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos sinua innostavat asiakaspalvelu, myynti, liiketoiminta ja tavoitteellinen työskentely. Työskentelyotteesi on aktiivinen ja rohkea, ja tartut ennakkoluulottomasti uusiin haasteisiin. Viihdyt ihmisten parissa, rakennat luottamusta ja yhteistyötä ympärilläsi sekä toimit sujuvasti monimuotoisessa työyhteisössä.

title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer (Data Center)
description:
**About us**

Established in 2006, Nordecon Oy is a multinational OEM company and solution provider specializing in complex end-to-end mobile, server, and custom-built desktop solutions. With nearly two decades of experience and a strong track record in delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions, the company is pivoting towards new opportunities. We are building a modern AI-focused Data Center in Finland designed for high-density GPU computing. Our infrastructure is being built from the ground up, giving you the opportunity to influence every aspect of the network architecture instead of maintaining legacy systems.

We are looking for an experienced Network & Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys designing, building and operating reliable infrastructure.

**What you will do**

You will be responsible for designing, implementing and operating the entire network infrastructure of the data center.

This role combines architecture, implementation and day-to-day technical ownership.

**Network Architecture**

- Design the complete data center network from the ground up.

- Develop scalable and resilient network architecture.

- Design physical fibre topology.

- Design IP addressing strategy.

- Design VLAN and VRF structure.

- Design rack connectivity standards.

- Produce and maintain network documentation.

- Plan future expansion of the infrastructure.


**External Connectivity**

- Design and maintain multi-ISP connectivity.

- Configure and operate BGP.

- Design Internet redundancy and failover.

- Coordinate network connectivity with providers.

- Plan future interconnection between multiple data center locations.


**Internal Network**

- Deploy and maintain switches, routers and firewalls.

- Configure Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking.

- Build management and out-of-band networks.

- Maintain network security.

- Troubleshoot complex networking issues.

- Support high-speed Ethernet environments (25G / 100G / 400G).


**Monitoring & Automation**

- Build network monitoring and alerting.

- Integrate infrastructure into monitoring platforms.

- Automate repetitive operational tasks.

- Maintain accurate documentation.

- Improve operational reliability.


**Infrastructure Integration**

Work closely with electrical and mechanical contractors to integrate infrastructure into a unified monitoring platform.

Examples include:

- UPS

- Generators

- Cooling systems

- Water pumps

- Fire detection systems

- Environmental monitoring

- Building Management System (BMS)


Experience with Modbus, BACnet or similar industrial protocols is an advantage but **not required**.

**Required Skills**

- Strong networking knowledge.

- Experience designing and deploying enterprise or data center networks.

- Cisco, Juniper, Arista or similar platforms.

- TCP/IP.

- BGP.

- OSPF.

- VLAN.

- LACP.

- Linux administration.

- Fibre networking.

- Excellent troubleshooting skills.

- Good documentation practices.

- Ability to independently deliver technical projects.


**Nice to Have**

- EVPN / VXLAN.

- Spine-Leaf architectures.

- Network automation.

- Python.

- Ansible.

- Grafana.

- Prometheus.

- Zabbix.

- GPU cluster networking.

- AI/HPC infrastructure.

- Kubernetes.

- Docker.

- Modbus.

- BACnet.


**What we are looking for**

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building infrastructure rather than simply maintaining existing environments.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of technical decisions, designing solutions from scratch and implementing them yourself.

You don't need to know everything. We value strong networking fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.

**What we offer**

- Opportunity to build a modern AI Data Center from the ground up.

- Freedom to influence technical decisions.

- Modern infrastructure.

- High level of technical ownership.

- Long-term career growth.

- Competitive salary based on experience.


**Work Setup**

Location: Riihimäki, Finland (hybrid work possible but on-site presence required at times)

Type: Full-time, permanent

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience. Start: As soon as a suitable candidate is found but the start date is flexible.

**Interested?**

Send your CV, short introduction, and salary request to **applications@nordecon.fi**.

If you have questions, feel free to reach out, were happy to discuss the role in more detail.

**Please note:** Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to respond individually to each applicant. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**The opportunity**

Hitachi Energy is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Technical Project Manager at Grid Automation business in Vaasa or Helsinki, Finland. You will be working on domestic and global services that typically consist of SCADA/DMS and RTU deliveries to end customers. This is a role for someone who has good leadership and management skills as well as a strong can-do mindset. You will successfully secure that the team can plan, execute and complete the services to our customers globally.

We offer you the opportunity to develop your project management competence in various ways and the possibility to work with both domestic and global customers in the areas of utility, industry, transportation and infrastructure. In this position, you will have the opportunity to further your career to a senior position, or in sales or general management.

**How youll make an impact**

- Leading the project team with clear guidelines, tasks and milestones, while motivating and providing feedback.

- Managing all aspects of the project to agreed-upon customer requirements and ensuring all technical, safety, quality and financial targets are met.

- Participating in domestic and export service projects of various sizes as a technical engineer.

- Overseeing the development of project plan documents in relation to scope, budget, schedule, and risk management.

- Monitoring each stage of project implementation to ensure best practices in cost control, resource efficiency, risk management and health, safety and the environment.

- Supporting our end-customers with your technical expertise, leading to better user experience, higher customer satisfaction and long-term collaboration.

- Identifying, analyzing and addressing service project risks, with the regular sharing of lessons learned.

- Providing technical support for our sales teams in designing the scope to be offered.

- Coordinating contract negotiation and claims with customers, in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Legal functions.

- Achieving service project deliverables and compliance with contract requirements. Building strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.


**Your background**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

- Project Management certification is considered as a benefit.

- Experience in SAP, MS Office and MS Project.

- Good communication skills in Finnish and in English.

- Willingness to work in a flexible project team.

title: Account Manager
description:
Carpenter Co. is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, serving a diverse global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide. Our Kouvola facility produces traditional comfort solutions, mattresses (both consumer & medical) and technical foams including rolls and bonded foam applications.

We are looking for an Account Manager to join our Finnish team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing sales and strengthening Carpenter's market position in Finland. You will work closely with existing customers while actively identifying new business opportunities within the manufacturing industry. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of your customer portfolio, influence commercial strategy, and contribute directly to business growth in a global market-leading company.

What you'll do

- Drive the commercial growth of Carpenter Comfort Solutions in Finland.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and key stakeholders.

- Identify, pursue, and convert new business opportunities and market segments.

- Develop and execute sales plans aligned with business objectives.

- Monitor market developments, customer needs, and industry trends.

- Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, contracts, and business terms.

- Support profitability by managing pricing strategies and commercial risks.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer experience and business performance.

What we're looking for

- At least 5 years of experience selling materials, components, or technical solutions to manufacturing industry customers.

- Experience managing and developing your own customer portfolio.

- A proven track record in acquiring new customers and growing sales.

- Strong commercial acumen and experience negotiating pricing and contracts.

- Experience developing and implementing sales strategies and business plans.

- The ability to identify market trends and translate them into commercial opportunities.

- Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical sales.

- Experience in polyurethane, furniture or bedding industry.

- Experience managing distributors, dealers, or key accounts in the Nordic market.

- A background in B2B sales and business development.

Location & Travel

This role requires regular travel within Finland to meet customers, develop business opportunities, and support market growth. Our Finnish team is based in Kouvola, and monthly visits to the office are expected.

Apply Now

To ensure a consistent recruitment process, all applications and CVs must be submitted in English through our recruitment system via [this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/account-manager/ZlEGpp) no later than 7 September 2026. We review and interview candidates throughout the application period, and the position may be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.


Carpenter Engineered Foams Oy

Founded in 1950, Carpenter Co. is the worlds largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. Carpenter also serves a diversified global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 70 production locations. Our 6,500+ employees across the globe seek to provide the most innovative products and solutions with a focus on enhancing the quality of peoples lives while being a good steward of our resources.

At Carpenter, you'll find a rewarding career in a stable company, diverse experiences and an unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. As part of our team, you'll collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues whose sense of purpose complements your own.

title: Emission Measurement Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Emission Measurement Engineer to strengthen the Emissions & Automation team in ourTesting & Validation Test Services. The location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, and the work is carried out at the Sustainable Technology Hub (STH) in Vaskiluoto.

Your role and responsibilities

We operate in the STH Plant, close to the test cells in the Hub and Research Lab. We strive to continuously improve our measurement methods and maintain our equipment in top condition. Youll be working as part of a dedicated team with diverse expertise.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Carry out emission measurements in STH on production engines, test engines, and single-cylinder research engines
* Be part of a team developing new methods for emission measurements and continue the ongoing work of automating recurring emission measurements
* Develop your knowledge and expertise in the emission measurement area in the longer term, to also cover fuel gas analysis, measurement of particulates, and/or other more advanced methods
* Perform maintenance and calibration of the emission measurement equipment



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Relevant technical education (BSc or MSc, or equivalent, in Chemical, Environmental, Automation, or Electrical Engineering)
* Good understanding of technology and product development – knowledge of the Wärtsilä engine product family, systems, and solutions is seen as a benefit
* Strong internal motivation, passion for execution, and drive to get things completed
* Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Good teamwork skills
* Proactive and self-driven approach with a doers attitude
* Good English skills; Finnish and/or Swedish skills are an advantage
* Structured way of working and planning
* Willingness to learn and adapt



Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

For further questions, please reach out to Staffan Nysand, Manager, Emissions & Automation, through staffan.nysand@wartsila.com or by phone at +358 50 534 3944 with any questions related to this position (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications submitted via email will not be recorded or responded to).

title: Customer Service Agent, Turku tai Kuhmo
description:
**Oletko asiakaspalvelun moniosaaja – tai haluatko kasvaa sellaiseksi?**

Tykkäätkö ratkaista ongelmia, kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä ja siitä fiiliksestä, kun asiakkaan asia tulee kerralla kuntoon?

**Saatat olla juuri se tyyppi, jota etsimme DialOk:lle Turkuun tai Kuhmoon!**

Haemme nyt uusia tekijöitä monipuolisiin asiakaspalvelutehtäviin. Tarjolla on **osa-aikaista työtä** (60-120h/kk).

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

DialOk:lla yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen. Tuotamme monikanavaista asiakaspalvelua useille suomalaisille yrityksille ja julkisen sektorin toimijoille, joten pääset työskentelemään erilaisten asiakkaiden ja tilanteiden parissa.

Palvelet asiakkaita **puhelimitse, sähköpostitse ja chatissa**. Tehtäviisi voi asiakkuudesta riippuen kuulua esimerkiksi:

- tilausten ja muiden yhteydenottojen hoitamista

- ajanvarausta

- asiakkaiden neuvontaa ja ongelmien ratkaisemista

- vaihteenhoitoa

- erilaisia back office -tehtäviä.


Työ ei sisällä puhelinmyyntiä.

Meillä onnistumista ei mitata sillä, kuinka nopeasti saat asiakkaan pois linjoilta, vaan sillä, että hänen asiansa tulee hoidettua **ammattimaisesti, ystävällisesti ja mahdollisimman sujuvasti**. Tavoitteemme on yksinkertainen: ensiluokkainen palvelukokemus – kanavasta riippumatta.

**Missä ja milloin töitä tehdään?**

Voit työskennellä viihtyisällä toimistollamme **Turussa tai Kuhmossa**. Kun talo, työtehtävät ja toimintatapamme ovat tulleet tutuiksi, tarjoamme mahdollisuuden myös osittaiseen **etätyöhön** perehdytyksen jälkeen.

Työajat sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin **klo 7–18**, mutta vuoroja on tarjolla myös iltaisin, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Osa-aikaisilta työntekijöiltä toivomme mahdollisuutta sitoutua vähintään **kahteen työvuoroon viikossa**.

**Millainen tyyppi pärjää meillä?**

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis asiakaspalvelun supersankari ensimmäisenä työpäivänä. Tärkeämpää meille on oikea asenne, halu oppia ja aito kiinnostus ihmisten auttamiseen.

Toivomme sinulta:

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin kielen taito on etu

- positiivista ja palveluhenkistä asennetta

- kykyä pitää pää kylmänä myös kiireessä

- selkeää, rauhallista ja ystävällistä puhetyyliä

title: Vuokra-/kiinteistönvälittäjä Lappeenranta
description:
Meiltä löytyy toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä! Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavasta organisaatiosta, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen työssäsi menestymiseen.

Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, jolta löytyy kyky laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamiseen. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä suoritettua LVV- tai LKV-tutkintoa. Osaat aikatauluttaa omaa työntekoasi ja työskentelet tarkalla otteella. Työ on lähtökohtaisesti osa-aikaista, mutta mahdollisuus myös kokoaikaiseen työhön. Oma auto on tässä työssä välttämätön.

Teemme välitystyötä modernilla otteella, suunnitelmallisesti ja jatkuvasti uudistuen. Toivomme, että sinulla on niin osaamista kuin halua erilaisten digitaalisten välineiden ja järjestelmien kuin sosiaalisen mediankin hyödyntämiseen.

Meidän rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä on helppo viihtyä. Saat aina tarvittaessa myös apua työkavereilta. Tulet saamaan työnantajan puolesta jonkin verran toimeksiantoja, jotta aloitus meillä olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa.

Joustavan työajan lisäksi tarjoamme kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen ja korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä johtuvat kilometrit. Työsuhde-etuna pääset seuraamaan asuntosijoittamista läheltä ja ensimmäisenä mukaan sijoitusasuntojen tarjouksiimme.

title: People Business Partner
description:
At NORMAL we are looking for an experienced People Business Partner in Finland who will be an important part of our People Business Partner team. You will be based at our head office in Helsinki but will primarily have activities in stores - in your regions in the country.

**Your role**

As a People Business Partner, you will be the link between our People Development initiatives and the everyday life in our Finnish stores. You will be given a wide range of tasks – from recruitment and onboarding to leadership development and business partnering – all with a focus on developing both people and the organization. You will participate in leadership group meetings and contribute actively to the People agenda.

**Your responsibilities**

· Drive and support recruitment processes primarily at management level

· Be a close sparring partner for the leaders in your regions - also in relation to strengthening our leadership pipeline

· Drive and support onboarding of new employees and managers

· Teach at our internal management training courses and run workshops

· Facilitate leadership development initiatives and ensure that concepts become practice

· Contribute to the development and implementation of People Development activities in everyday life

**Who are you?**

You are an empathetic relationship builder who meets people at eye level, and you are able to create trust and support among both managers and employees. You have a high drive, like to take initiative and do not wait for others to get you started. You think business and people together - and can translate strategic initiatives into concrete actions. You are also ambitious as a sparring partner and not afraid to get involved.

You thrive in an informal culture where there is room for the crazy and quirky while at the same time, we chase results and have big ambitions.

You communicate fluently in Finnish and English.

**We also imagine that you:**

· have years of experience with recruitment and leadership development – preferably from a larger retail organization

· have worked in a leadership role yourself

· can teach and facilitate with impact and energy

· thrive in an environment with pace, growth and many stakeholders

**Who are we?**

The culture at NORMAL is unpretentious, and we meet each other at eye level with the common goal of achieving success and results – while having a lot of fun and running fast. We believe in US more than ME, so we also help each other when things are busy. The employees have a high degree of influence, as we want to create a workplace based on trust and responsibility for the individual.

**Normal offers you:**

An exciting and challenging responsibility in a rapidly growing company. With us, you will become part of a big family, where we are motivated by self-development and our common goal to make Normal the best place possible for both our customers and employees.

Our working environment at NORMAL's Finnish headquarters and stores is youthful, international and fun, and we have a good can-do attitude. The company's values are an important part of our daily lives and thus we offer the opportunity to develop in a supportive work environment.

**Do you want to be part of the team?**

If you are interested in the position, please send us a motivated CV and an application with a few words about yourself and why you would be a good fit for this position. You are also welcome to reach out for questions to our Head of People Development, Morten Max on +4530248611.

We will be conducting interviews as we go, and we will hire the right candidate as soon as we have found that individual.

We look forward to receiving your application

title: Vastaanottovirkailija Kolin hotelleihin
description:

LIEKSA

Hei sinä hotellialan ammattilainen, kuuletko Kolin kutsun? Tule työkaveriksemme iloiseen Pohjois-Karjalaan, keskelle Kolin häikäisevän kaunista kansallismaisemaa.

Haemme vastaanottovirkailijaa Kolin hotelleihin

Break Sokos Hotel Koli sijaitsee kuvankauniissa kansallismaisemassa Kolin vaarojen laella ja Break Sokos Hotel Koli Kylä on Kolin kylän lämminhenkinen sydän. Yhteensä hotelleissa on 209 huonetta, kansallismaisemaan avautuva Koli Relax Spa ja useita ravintoloita.

Haemme nyt asiakaspalvelun sydämensä asiaksi kokevaa hotellialan ammattilaista työskentelemään hotelliemme vastaanotossa. Vastaanotossamme vastaat asiakkaidemme onnistuneesta hotellikokemuksesta niin aamu- kuin iltavuorossakin, arkena ja viikonloppuna. Olet tehokas ja energinen ammattilainen ja nautit asiakkaiden palvelemisesta. Teet työtäsi innostuneesti, positiivisella otteella ja osaat toimia myös paineen alla etkä hätkähdä vaihtelevia tilanteita. Olet sosiaalinen, joustava ja sinulla on hyvät yhteistyötaidot.

Työnkuvaasi kuuluu myös kahvilan ja ravintolan avustavat työtehtävät, uniikin maisemakylpylä Koli Relax Span lipunmyynti sekä Koli Safariksen avustavat työtehtävät vuokravälineiden parissa.

Edellytämme sinulta hotellin vastaanottotyön aiempaa kokemusta, vähintään englannin sujuvaa kielitaitoa, anniskelu- ja hygieniapassia ja ajokorttia, aktiivista ja positiivista asennetta sekä osaamista digitalisoituvassa työympäristössä. Eduksi katsomme Opera Cloud-järjestelmän tuntemuksen.

Työtunteja tarjoamme sinulle 60 h / 3 vk ja työsuhde on määräaikainen, työt alkavat 21.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan aiemmin ja työsuhde on voimassa 3.1.2027 saakka.

Monipuolisen työskentely-ympäristön lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi isossa toimipaikkaverkostossamme. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja tuemme sinua onnistumaan tehtävässäsi.

Hakuaika päättyy6.9.2026tai sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten hae jo tänään! Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa hotellipäällikkö Noora Väisänen,noora.vaisanen@sok.fi, tai puhelimitse +358 10762 3640 arkisin klo 9–15.

title: Apulaisravintolapäällikkö Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna
description:
Primary location:
VAASA

Haemme APULAISRAVINTOLAPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna Vaasassa toimiviin ravintola- ja kokoustoimintoihin.

Haemme nyt rohkeaa ja tuloshakuista päällikköä vetämään ja johtamaan huipputiimiä. Jos tunnet suurta paloa ravintola-alaa ja ihmisiä kohtaan, tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn, jossa pääset näyttämään taitosi ja edelleen kehittymään.

Tässä roolissa saat mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa sekä työntekijöiden että vieraiden arkeen. Työn ytimessä ovat onnistuneen työntekijäkokemuksen johtaminen, loistavan vieraskokemuksen varmistaminen sekä tuloksellisuus. Tehdään yhdessä vieraidemme arjesta juhlaa!

Pidät huolta, että tiimisi kukoistaa ja työntekijäsi voivat hyvin. Olet tärkeässä osassa kannustavan työkulttuurin kehittämisessä. Meillä jokainen tuntee olevansa osa tiimiä sekä pääsee halutessaan kehittymään. Tiedämme, että innostuneet työntekijät saavat aikaan ilahtuneita vieraita, ja tämä filosofia näkyy kaikessa tekemisessämme.

Tiedät, että menestyminen edellyttää myös liiketoiminnan tunnuslukujen ymmärtämistä ja osaamista: Ymmärrät alan perusrealiteetit, tunnistat mahdollisuudet ja haasteet sekä kykenet tekemään tarvittavia muutoksia liiketoiminnan kannattavuuden varmistamiseksi. Olet rohkea päätösten tekijä ja johdat tiimiäsi esimerkillä kohti tavoitteita.

Tyypillinen työviikko tai -päivä on täynnä monipuolisia haasteita, jotka otat vastaan innostuneesti. Työaikasi painottuu arki-iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin – silloinhan vieraammekin ovat meillä! Jokainen kohtaaminen vieraan kanssa on mahdollisuus luoda positiivista kaikua, joten pyrit jatkuvasti parantamaan palvelun laatua ja vastaamaan vieraan tarpeisiin.

Odotamme sinulta selkeää viestintää ja kykyä kannustaa tiimiäsi parhaisiin suorituksiin. Kielitaitosi on meille arvokas resurssi. title: Myyjä, Sale Suomusjärvi ja Sale Kiikala
description:
Primary location:
SALO

Etsimme nyt MYYJÄÄ vakituiseen tehtävään Suomusjärven & Kiikalan Saleen! Tehtävä on osa-aikainen, 20 h/vko.Myyjän työ sopii sinulle, joka innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja tekemisen meiningistä. Siitä on tietysti hyötyä, jos olet työskennellyt vastaavissa tehtävissä jo aiemmin, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä – me perehdytämme kyllä!

Salen myyjänä teet ihan tavallisia töitä:työpäiväsi täyttyvät asiakaskohtaamisista, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallinnasta. Tavallisuus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita tylsää tai merkityksetöntä – päinvastoin! Meille tavallista on asiakkaiden hurmaaminen leveällä hymyllä ja reippaalla työotteella.

Toivomme, että pidät asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta, tiimityöskentelystä, fyysisestä työstä ja reippaasta työtahdista. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa aamu- päivä- ja iltavuoroissa n. klo 7–21 välillä. Tehtävä edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä sekä Kiikalan että Suomusjärven Salessa. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on tarpeen toimipisteiden sijainnin vuoksi.

Haluamme vastaavasti tarjota sinulle
Ihan tavallisia töitä, ja erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.

Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tuntipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan välille 10,89–14,57 € /h. Ja lisät päälle!

Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.

Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.

Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko kotimyymälässäsi tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.

Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana.


💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 20 h/vko
Työt alkavat: syyskuussa 2026 sopimuksen mukaan
Huomaathan, että haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla, ja valintapäätökset tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

📞Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa arkisin klo 8–16 myymäläpäällikköElina Valdemarsson joko puhelimitse p. 044320 5780 tai sähköpostitse elina.valdemarsson@sok.fi

Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessasso.fi/toihinmeille.

title: Fibre Home Installation Technician (Customer Visits)
description:
Work takes place in customers homes and small property environments. You follow a standard installation process and ensure a high-quality finish.
This role does not include fusion splicing, fibre blowing, or digging/excavation.

Key duties

Agree the installation point and indoor device location with the customer (dry/warm location, close to power).
Plan and mark the yard route, considering obstacles such as cables/pipes/paving.
Complete the wall entry, sleeve, careful feed of the pre-terminated fibre cable, and sealing.
Mount the outdoor termination box and indoor media converter; tidy surface routing where needed.
Documentation and handover to the next phase.
Requirements

Prior experience in installation / field service / technician work.
Driving licence (B).
Fluent Finnish.
Good English.
Comfortable with in-home customer visits.
Splicing/blowing experience is not required.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**The Role**

**We're looking for a Data Scientist to do the quantitative analysis behind a large-scale data quality program. When our data engineering team's monitors flag a statistical anomaly in large, human-generated rating and annotation data, you'll be the one who determines whether it's genuine signal or ordinary noise, and if it's real, what's actually driving it. You'll triage confirmed findings into the right remediation lane, turn your analysis into fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups, and help build the dashboards and reporting views that make your findings visible to the team and stakeholders. You'll operate on a two-week sprint cadence as part of a small, distributed team, reporting into the program's Data Scientist Lead.**

**What You'll Do**

- **Take anomalies flagged by the data engineering team's monitoring systems and apply statistical methods (hypothesis testing, distributional comparisons, cohort/segment analysis) to classify each as genuine signal or ordinary noise/drift.**

- **Run root-cause analysis on confirmed anomalies in rating/annotation data — for example, comparing cohorts to identify what distinguishes an outlier group from the rest of the population — to identify the likely driver.**

- **Triage confirmed findings into the correct remediation lane: contributor-side issues (route to our internal Quality team for remediation) versus process-side issues (route back to the client's program team as a guideline or workflow fix).**

- **Turn analysis into clear, concise, fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups that feed the team's stakeholder cadence, owned by the Data Scientist Lead.**

- **Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting views (in partnership with data engineering) that surface anomaly trends, cohort findings, and turnaround metrics to the team and stakeholders.**

- **Work within tight, SLA-driven turnaround windows, delivering diagnosis-ready findings within hours — not days — once an issue is flagged.**

- **Participate fully in a two-week sprint cadence: sprint planning, review, and continuous improvement of analysis methodology.**

- **Collaborate cross-functionally with data engineers, the Data Scientist Lead, and program/quality stakeholders across a distributed, international team.**


**What You'll Need**

- **3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Statistician, or Quantitative Analyst.**

- **Strong background in statistical analysis and hypothesis testing — comfortable choosing and applying the right test (e.g., distributional comparison tests) to determine whether two groups genuinely differ.**

- **Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including standard statistical/analysis libraries.**

- **Demonstrated experience distinguishing genuine patterns from noise or drift in large, messy, human-generated datasets.**

- **Experience with BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Data Studio).**

- **Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with short sprint cycles.**

- **Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable producing clear write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.**


**Nice to Have**

- **Experience with anomaly and drift detection on human-rated, crowdsourced, or annotation-based datasets.**

- **Prior experience in a data quality, trust & safety, content moderation, or crowdsourced-data environment.**

- **Familiarity with cohort or segmentation profiling techniques for large populations.**


**Project Overview**

**Location: Remote from Finland**

**Type: Full-time, fixed-term engagement of approximately 6 months, with potential to extend based on program needs.**

title: Requirements Engineer
description:
_Basemark | Automotive Software Projects_

_About the Role: Basemark is looking for a_**_Requirements Engineer_** _to join our automotive software engineering team. In this role, you will work within a customer-facing automotive project delivering advanced software solutions for a leading automotive manufacturer. You will play a key part in ensuring that customer and system requirements are accurately captured, structured, and maintained throughout the development lifecycle, in full compliance with ASPICE processes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical detail and cross-functional communication, working closely with automotive OEM stakeholders and internal engineering teams. What You'll Do:_

- _Gather, analyze, structure, and maintain functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR (Augmented Reality) projects._

- _Establish and maintain bi-directional traceability between customer requirements (SYS.2) and software requirements (SWE.1)._

- _Manage change requests, including impact analysis, throughout the requirements lifecycle._

- _Ensure compliance with ASPICE processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10), supporting process assessments and audit readiness._

- _Act as a key point of contact with automotive OEM representatives to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into actionable engineering requirements._

- _Facilitate requirement reviews between engineering teams, ensuring alignment and clarity across disciplines._

- _Support problem resolution processes related to requirements and specifications._


_What We're Looking For_

- **_At least 5 years of hands-on experience_** _with ASPICE Software Engineering processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10)._

- _Solid knowledge of process assessments, audit readiness, and traceability compliance, as well as problem resolution and change request management._

- _Proven track record in gathering, analyzing, structuring, and maintaining functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR projects._

- _Proven experience establishing bi-directional traceability (Customer Requirements SYS.2 Software Requirements SWE.1) and managing change requests with impact analysis._

- _Proficiency with industry-standard tools for requirements lifecycle management (IBM DOORS, CodeBeamer, PTC Integrity, Jira, Confluence)._

- _Direct experience interacting with automotive OEMs to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into engineering requirements._

- _Experience facilitating requirement reviews between engineering teams._

- _Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives._

- _Fluent English; additional languages are a plus._


_Location & Compensation_

- **_Location:_** _Helsinki, Finland. The role is primarily based at our office, with on-site presence expected for most of the work week._

- **_Salary:_** **_EUR 33,500 - 33,700 per year_**_._

You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement — with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on projects used by major automotive manufacturers._

title: Senior Research Fellow / Yliopistotutkija (Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature, within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering)
description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences)at Tampere University invites applications for a fixed-term Senior Research Fellow position in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature for a two-year period starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).

The position is open within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering (MePhiS), funded by the Research Council of Finland, and its research team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature. Among the five research teams of MePhiS, four are hosted by the Faculty of Theology at the University of Helsinki, while the team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature is hosted by the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University. The Centre offers a supportive and inspiring research environment and excellent opportunities for researchers to develop their careers in an international and interdisciplinary setting. More information about MePhiS is available at: www.helsinki.fi/mephis .

MePhiS engages in philosophical and interdisciplinary scholarship that places the concept of suffering at the centre of philosophical reflection and offers conceptual and argumentative tools for a deeper understanding of human engagement with affliction, starting from the meliorist (Lat. melior, better) idea that the world can and should be made better through active human efforts. According to meliorism, a positive outcome is neither guaranteed (optimism) nor impossible (pessimism).

The research group on Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature within MePhiS focuses on literary studies and the philosophy of literature as pathways to a meliorist philosophy of suffering. We take seriously the idea that literature can articulate philosophical questions and shape peoples ways of experiencing, expressing, and coping with suffering. The group critically examines writers and literary traditions associated with optimism, pessimism, and/or meliorism, and analyses literary works that reflect societal anxieties as well as human or non-human suffering arising from war, violence, poverty, marginalisation, the climate crisis, and related challenges. We also investigate how philosophers draw on literature in developing ethical responses to suffering.

Position

Towards these ends, we invite applications for a Senior Research Fellow with a background in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature with demonstrated interest in advancing research in these fields.

The Senior Research Fellow will be responsible for

- investigating representations of suffering and meliorism in literary and philosophical contexts;
- developing literary and philosophical analyses of ethical responses to suffering;
- authoring scholarly publications on the research topic;
- collaborating with other members of the Centre of Excellence, including through joint publications and other research activities; and
- contributing to teaching and administrative duties, amounting to approximately 5-10% of the working time.

Qualifications

We seek candidates with expertise in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature who are interested in advancing the research aims described above. Applicants must hold a doctoral degree in a relevant field within the humanities or social sciences (e.g., literary studies, philosophy) and have a demonstrated track record of high-quality research and international publications. A Senior Research Fellow typically has at least ca. five years of postdoctoral experience. In addition, applicants should possess the ability to lead a research group, a track record of securing external research funding, and the teaching skills required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of the position.

Familiarity with the topics of suffering, optimism, pessimism, or meliorism in literature and philosophy, as well as experience in combining literary studies with philosophical inquiry, will be considered an advantage.

The selected candidate should be capable of conducting independent research at a high international level and able to work both independently and collaboratively as a member of the research team. The working language of MePhiS is English, and excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

Applicants should be prepared to provide proof of their qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated proposals.

We offer

The position is fixed-term for two years starting in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

The salary will be based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). The salary of a Senior Research Fellow is at levels 6-7. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary (level 6) is approximately EUR 4,700-4,900 per month.

The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us?navref=footer). International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).
