Are you ready to lead and innovate at the intersection of IT and production? Join Scania as an IT Manager for Engine & Fuel system Assembly and drive our transformation journey!

In this role, you will be an integral part of both the IT and production unit management teams. You will contribute to setting the direction and strategic plan for both IT and the production unit and implement it. You will also support the production unit in their transformation journey, driving and supporting both management teams to ensure continuous development. You and your team will be responsible for securing daily operations and maintaining the current IT landscape lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities

    Strategic Development: Actively contribute to and focus on cross-collaboration and strategic development within both IT and production management teams.
    Vision and Direction: Contribute to both IT and the production unit vision, creating prerequisites for a flow-oriented way of working that improves day-to-day deliveries and secures the cross-functional E2E perspective.

    Team Leadership: Coach the team, inspire continuous improvement, and ensure the team's competence development in new technologies.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced manager with relevant education and experience in production and/or IT. You should have a deep understanding of direction, be able to explain the "why," transform in the desired direction and drive game-changing assignments. As a servant leader, you value agility, innovation, and collaboration. You have proven skills in building relationships both internally and externally and see collaboration as the key to success. Your ability to see beyond the present and plan for the future is essential. You take an active role in improvement work and secure a game-changer mindset. You are open to change, take initiative, and drive the organization forward with Scania's goals and values as benchmarks. You believe in a learning organization and create conditions for the team to grow and develop.

At Scania, we believe embracing AI is essential for our continued growth and innovation. We are committed to provide our employees with the latest AI tools and fostering an environment where AI skills are encouraged. You don’t need prior experience with AI – but we expect curiosity, openness and a positive attitude towards learning and applying AI in your role.

This Is Us

Today, we are a section with 6 team where 5 of the teams are in Södertälje and 1 in Luleå. We are now searching for our new colleague who is curious to take on this challenging and exiting position as IT manager for the Engine and Fuel system assembly team.

The team responsible for IT deliveries within the Engine and Fuel system assembly, have many ongoing and upcoming initiatives driven by new business models and Industry 4.0. We will also implement a new ERP system to modernize our system landscape and support the growing business demands. This requires an experienced manager who has the ability and motivation to manage a complex IT delivery, which takes place both locally and globally. To secure the high load of IT demands, the IT delivery have both own IT development and managed service set ups.

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic, flexible workplace with hybrid work options, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally. Benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents enjoy direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job express buses.

Application

Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-28. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence subject (RAI) (http://www.ltu.se/robotics) at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a Postdoc contributing to our growing activities. The RAI team are conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on Aerial and Space robotics.

The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are robotics for mines, construction sites, aerial inspection of aging infrastructure, multi-robotic search and rescue, multi sensorial fusion and multirobot coordination, including multirobot perception, decentralization and mission execution.

The RAI team has a strong European participation in multiple R&D&I projects, while RAI was also participating in the DARPA SUB-T challenge with the CoSTAR Team lead by NASA/JPL (https://costar.jpl.nasa.gov/).

Subject description

Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.

Project description

The research topic is in the area of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. More specifically, the position will involve dense research activities in the area of designing, experimenting and theoretical development with the following combined research areas. Previous experience in one or preferably more topics from these areas is considered a merit.

    5G reconfigurable Connectivity
    5G/6G QoS
    Control of Communication networks
    Markovian Processes
    Network Based Localisation / Radio based connectivity
    Adaptive bandwidth
    Mesh networking
    Wireless Sensor Networks
    Edge Computing
    Time Delayed Systems
    Adaptive Queuing

Duties

The duties of a Postdoc primarily comprise research. You will perform research with substantial experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of PhD and MSc students, teaching and supporting in acquiring funds for future research projects from research funding agencies/councils, EU framework program or industry.

Qualifications

In order to be eligible for employment as post doctor you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Automatic control or related subject. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.

The research tasks require a solid mathematical background with proven advanced experimental capabilities and excellent programming skills (e.g. C++, ROS, Matlab, etc.). You should have a strong vision to evaluate and demonstrate the research findings in real life operating conditions, in an approach to close the gap between pure theory and experimental verifications. You will need to represent the group in different contexts, both in Sweden and abroad and hence have excellent skills in English.

Further information

The employment is limited to 2 years with possibility to be extended 1 year.

Placement: Luleå. Starting: Start according to agreement.

Application

The application should include a detailed CV with a full description of all the scientific merits and publications of the candidate, motivation letter, a research plan with a description of the research topics, list of successful grant applications, list of 2 persons that could provide recommendation for the candidate and copies of verified and translated diplomas from high school and universities. title: Temporary substitute Bioinformatician at the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform
description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

The Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC) is a world-leading research center in plant physiology and forest genetics. Its research activities generate large volumes of data that require bioinformatics resources and software for analysis. UPSC is a collaboration between the Department of Plant Physiology at Umeå University and the Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU). Within SLU, a university-wide infrastructure currently provides bioinformatics support: the SLU Bioinformatics Infrastructure (SLUBI). As SLUBI will be phased out by the end of 2026, a bioinformatics position is being established within the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform (UPSCb). UPSCb is part of the broader bioinformatics environment in Umeå, most of which is co-located with UPSC, comprising more than thirty professionals working for both local and national organizations (for example, SciLifeLab NBIS).

In your role within the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform (UPSCb), you will provide bioinformatics support and services to research groups and participate in a variety of projects. The position involves managing several projects simultaneously. Projects are typically short-term, lasting a few months, and often require close collaboration with biologists. To ensure that data analyses carried out within the platform maintain a high standard, you will participate in bioinformatics seminars every other week and take part in the platform's study sessions once a week. The platform supports participation in courses and workshops for professional development and is also involved in delivering such training at both local and national levels. You can expect to work on short, challenging projects in a supportive and dynamic work environment and, over time, take responsibility for the analysis of multiple research projects.

Your profile

We are looking for candidates who hold a PhD in computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related field. You should be highly familiar with Unix/Linux and at least one programming language such as Python, R, C, or C++. Strong collaboration skills and excellent English proficiency are required. UPSC is an international environment, and the position requires a strong ability to interact with biologists, who make up the primary user group of the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform (UPSCb). UPSCb also provides user support, in some cases over extended periods and for more comprehensive projects. Therefore, previous experience in supervision, mentoring, or teaching is considered an advantage. As you will be an important member of the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform, a small unit consisting of five employees, you must demonstrate a strong ability to independently organize, manage, and report your work.

You will work alongside other experts within the platform and the broader bioinformatics community, who are often highly specialized in specific technologies such as RNA-Seq, metagenomics, or epigenetics. Therefore, experience in processing and integrating multi-omics data (for example genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics) is considered meritorious. Population-related projects are also common, making experience with whole-genome studies and eQTL mapping an additional advantage.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Temporary substitute employment 12 months

Scope:

100%

Start date:

As agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 01 September 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Group Manager – R&D Turbine Mechanical Integrity Rotor Components
description:
The R&D TURBINE department is growing and consequently we are expanding from five to six groups. We are now looking for you who have a high interest in becoming Group Manager leading our newly established team— Mechanical Integrity Rotor Components (MIR).

In this role, you will not be stepping into an isolated leadership position. On the contrary, you will become part of a supportive management team where collaboration, shared responsibility, and mutual support are fundamental. As a new Group Manager, you can expect strong backing from experienced colleagues across the department, creating a safe and encouraging environment for you to grow and succeed in your role.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As the manager of MIR, you will be part of a team responsible for the reliability of our high-loaded turbine rotor and hot gas components. The group are actively taking part in highly varied and challenging areas, such as technology & innovation, development of new and existing products, prototype testing, failure investigations, support to the workshop, procurement, and sales projects.

Your day will be a balanced mix of people leadership, technical direction, and strategic work. You will focus on developing and supporting your team and its individuals while at the same time contributing to department strategy, project planning, and continuous operational improvement.

A key part of your role is the close and structured collaboration with the Group Manager for Mechanical Integrity Stator Components (MIS). Together, you will work as a leadership pair with a shared responsibility for mechanical integrity, actively shaping how the two groups collaborate, align technologies, and develop common ways of working.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Foster a safe and inclusive work environment for all employees
    Short- and long-term development of group competence
    Ensure quality and efficient work practices
    Continuous improvements of tools, criteria and guidelines
    Plan and prioritize team activities supporting daily operations
    Represent MIR group in the department’s leadership team

What You Bring

    Genuine interest in people development and team building
    A willingness to work long-term with continuous improvements to achieve strategic goals
    Excellent communication skills
    Basic understanding of turbine function and application.
    Knowledge within the area of mechanical integrity and materials is a plus but not a requirement
    Proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken

About the Team

The team currently consists of 8 permanent employees plus several consultants. The group is highly driven and innovative, at the absolute forefront within its area of responsibility, i.e. mechanical integrity, material development and material characterization. A typical task for a group member starts with stress/thermo-mechanical analysis as the basis for low cycle fatigue, creep, crack growth, and oxidation assessments. They work closely with teams that include senior MI engineers, designers, heat transfer engineers, and CFD engineers.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

title: Business Controller
description:
Scania Credit Group (SCA), one of the captive Scania Financial Services entities, offers financing and insurance in the Middle East, Central Asia, and West Africa. SCA has become a leader in factoring solutions for non-captive dealers and body-builders, supporting Scania's goal to reduce CCC and offload its balance sheet. We have partnered with external credit insurers to mitigate commercial and political risks in certain transactions. SCA is expanding into new markets, particularly in the AMC region.

Based in Södertälje, the SCA Head Office and Market Support Centre provides governance, strategic development, credit risk management, contract administration, and IT support. With 50 employees, including 30 in Södertälje, we manage around 250 MEUR of assets across 10+ markets.

At SCA we value team spirit, diversity and respect. We believe that every employee should be able to be themselves at work. Our corporate culture is characterized by respect for the individual, continuous improvement and always putting the customer first.  

Role Summary

Are you passionate about financial analysis, business partnering, and continuous improvement? Do you enjoy turning data into insights and contributing to business performance? Join our team as a Business Controller, where you will contribute to both day-to-day controlling activities and the continued evolution of our finance function.

This is a broad and engaging role where you will combine financial analysis and business controlling with process improvement and digitalization initiatives. As our business continues to grow, you will play an important role in strengthening reporting capabilities, enhancing finance processes, and providing insights that support better decision-making across the organization.

You will contribute to monthly closing and reporting activities, business planning, forecasting, and management reporting, while helping to build efficient and scalable ways of working for the future. The role offers broad exposure across finance and the opportunity to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple international markets.

Job Responsibilities

Main responsibilities include:

    Contribute to the monthly closing process together with the Finance team, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting
    Perform financial performance analysis, business follow-up, and forecast reporting to support informed decision-making
    Prepare, monitor, and follow up on budgets, forecasts, and long-term business plans
    Support Group reporting and help ensure high-quality financial reporting and compliance
    Prepare financial presentations, reporting material, and analyses for the Board, Regional Management, and Leadership Teams
    Collaborate closely with the Financial Controller to meet evolving reporting, governance, and compliance requirements
    Partner with the Business Controller on strategic initiatives, ad hoc analyses, and cross-functional projects that support business growth and continuous improvement
    Drive digitalization and automation initiatives within Finance to enhance reporting capabilities and ways of working
    Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, strengthen data quality, and support scalability
    Act as a key support for the organization regarding reporting guidelines, financial systems, and finance best practices
    Contribute to the development of controlling processes and internal controls as the business continues to grow



Who You Are

You enjoy working with numbers and transforming data into meaningful business insights, but you are equally motivated by improving processes and finding smarter ways of working. You are analytical, structured, and proactive, with the ability to balance attention to detail with a broader business perspective.

To succeed in this role, you:

    Hold a degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with a few years' experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting, or a similar role
    Have experience in financial reporting, planning, forecasting, and analysis
    Are analytical, curious, and solution-oriented
    Have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across functions
    Thrive in an international and dynamic business environment
    Are a team player who values knowledge sharing and collaboration
    Are fluent in English, both written and spoken
    Have excellent skills in Excel and PowerPoint
    Have experience with HFM, Power BI, or other finance systems (considered an advantage)



This Is Us

You'll be joining a Finance team of five colleagues based in Södertälje, where collaboration, trust, and knowledge sharing are at the heart of how we work. In this role, you will work closely with the Business Controller and Financial Controller, while partnering with colleagues across our international organization.

Our size allows for close collaboration, broad involvement across finance activities, and the opportunity to make a real impact. At the same time, our international presence provides exposure to colleagues and stakeholders across multiple markets and cultures.

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-28. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence subject (RAI) (www.ltu.se/robotics) at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a Postdoc contributing to our growing activities. The RAI team is conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on Aerial and Space robotics.



The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are robotics for mines, construction sites, aerial inspection of aging infrastructure, multi-robotic search and rescue, multi sensorial fusion and multirobot coordination, including multirobot perception, decentralization and mission execution.



The RAI team has a strong European participation in multiple R&D&I projects, while RAI was also participating in the DARPA SUB-T challenge with the CoSTAR Team lead by NASA/JPL (https://costar.jpl.nasa.gov/).



Subject description



Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.



Project description



You will be working in the field of robotics and artificial intelligence. More specifically, the position will involve dense research activities in the area of designing, experimenting and theoretical development with the following combined research areas linked with National, European and Worldwide R&D Projects.



Previous experience in one or preferably more topics from these areas is considered a merit:

    Multi-modal data processing for decision-making in natural environments
    Terrain classification and multi-layered environment mapping
    Digital twin generation for natural environments
    Semantic scene-understanding in natural environments for robust decision-making
    Learning-based traversability-aware path planning and safe trajectory generation
    Resilient mission design for applications such as soil sampling, surveillance etc.



Duties



The duties of a Postdoc primarily comprise research. You will perform research with substantial experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of PhD and MSc students, teaching and supporting in acquiring funds for future research projects from research funding agencies/councils, EU framework program or industry.



Qualifications



In order to be eligible for employment as post doctor you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Automatic control or electrical and electronics engineering or related subject. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.



The research tasks require a solid mathematical background with proven advanced experimental capabilities and excellent programming skills (e.g. C++, ROS, Matlab, etc.). You should have a strong vision to evaluate and demonstrate the research findings in real life operating conditions, in an approach to close the gap between pure theory and experimental verifications. You will need to represent the group in different contexts, both in Sweden and abroad and hence have excellent skills in English.



Further information



The employment is limited to 2 years with possibility to be extended 1 year.



Placement: Luleå. Starting: Start according to agreement.

title: Receptionist på deltid 8-13
description:
Trivs du i en roll där du får möta människor, skapa struktur och se till att kontoret fungerar som det ska? Som receptionist hos GlobalConnect i Uppsala blir du en viktig del av den dagliga kontorsupplevelsen för både medarbetare och besökare.

Det här är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid, med arbetstid kl. 08.00–13.00, fem dagar i veckan. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta deltid långsiktigt och uppskattar att kombinera service med administration och praktiskt kontorsstöd.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har

    Flytande svenska och professionell engelska i tal och skrift
    Möjlighet och ambition att arbeta deltid kl. 08.00–13.00, fem dagar i veckan, under överskådlig framtid
    Bekväm med att ge service både över telefon och i person.

Det är ett plus om du tidigare jobbat i service roller, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du har rätt motivation och är pålitlig och ansvarstagande.

Du blir en del av vårt Facility-team och utgår från kontoret i centrala Uppsala. Du rapporterar till Alexander som sitter i danmark och arbetar nära Tanya, som pur country lead för Sverige och Finland. Tanya finns på plats i Uppsala vissa dagar i veckan.

Du blir den enda receptionisten i Uppsala, samtidigt som du har en receptionist kollega i Stockholm att samarbeta med. Det innebär att du behöver känna dig bekväm med att själv planera din dag, se vad som behöver göras och ta ansvar för att arbetet går framåt.

Det här kommer du att arbeta med

    Ta emot och hjälpa besökare samt hantera inkommande telefonsamtal
    Hantera inkommande och utgående post och andra löpande receptionsuppgifter
    Hantera Facility-ärenden via Jira, mejl och Teams
    Ha kontakt med leverantörer, externa partners och fastighetsägare
    Stötta vid onboarding och offboarding samt se till att gemensamma ytor, mötesrum och kök fungerar väl
    Beställa kontorsmaterial och bidra i mindre Facility- och förbättringsprojekt
    Arbeta i facility relaterade förbättringsprojekt när tiden tillåter

Vem vi tror att du är

Du tycker om att hjälpa andra och känner dig bekväm både i personliga möten och i telefon. Du arbetar strukturerat, håller koll på vad som behöver göras och kan planera din dag även när ingen annan i teamet är på plats.

I den här rollen är det viktigt att du är pålitlig och tar initiativ. Under lugnare stunder ser du själv vad som kan förbättras eller göras klart, i stället för att vänta på nästa uppgift. Du uppskattar också en social vardag där du har kontakt med både kollegor, besökare och externa samarbetspartners.

Låter det här som du? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

    Inledande intervju med Talent Acquisition
    Första intervju Tanya
    Slutintervju med Alexander
    Referenstagning

Vänligen notera att personlighets- och kognitiva tester kommer att vara en del av processen.

Praktisk information

    Placering: GlobalConnects kontor i centrala Uppsala
    Arbetstid: kl. 08.00–13.00, måndag till fredag
    Rollen är kontorsbaserad och kräver närvaro på plats varje arbetsdag
    Vid enstaka tillfällen behöver du kunna arbeta från Stockholm, exempelvis vid semesterbemanning eller gemensamma teamaktiviteter

Det här är en roll för dig som vill bli en viktig del av vardagen på kontoret och kombinera service, eget ansvar och struktur i ett långsiktigt deltidsarbete.

Du behöver inte skicka något personligt brev – skicka bara ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil.

Välkommen med din ansökan till GlobalConnect.

GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

title: Maintenance Engineer - Laboratory & Utilities
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job

As Maintenance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and availability of Alfa Laval's laboratory assets, including test rigs, laboratory equipment, and supporting utility systems. This is a hands-on position where your practical technical expertise will help us strengthen our in-house maintenance capabilities, improve equipment reliability, and reduce downtime.



You will work closely with a highly technical team, supporting daily laboratory operations while also contributing to the development of maintenance routines, procedures, and best practices. With a broad range of equipment and technical challenges, the role offers plenty of variety and the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work on both daily operations and long-term improvements.



Your key responsibilities will include:

    

Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on test rigs, laboratory equipment, and utility systems.

    

Troubleshoot equipment failures and perform root cause analysis to identify effective solutions.

    

Support the installation, modification, and commissioning of new and existing laboratory equipment.

    

Plan and document maintenance activities in the CMMS.

    

Improve preventive maintenance routines and contribute to maintenance procedures and best practices.

    

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to increase equipment reliability and availability.

    

Provide technical support to laboratory operations and collaborate with colleagues and external suppliers.

    

Share technical knowledge and contribute to building a proactive maintenance culture within the team.



Who are you

You are a practical and proactive problem solver who enjoys being close to the equipment and figuring out how things work. You use your technical judgement to assess situations, identify root causes, and take ownership of finding effective solutions. You work in a structured and reliable way, while staying open to improving routines and how things are done. At the same time, you are collaborative and communicate clearly, sharing your knowledge and working closely with colleagues to solve problems and keep operations running reliably.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you bring solid practical maintenance experience combined with the technical understanding needed to troubleshoot, maintain, and improve a broad range of equipment. We believe our ideal candidate has:

    

Several years of practical experience in maintenance, troubleshooting, and equipment support, ideally 5 years or more.

    

Hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting industrial equipment.

    

Experience with the installation and modification of technical equipment.

    

Experience from industrial, laboratory, or production environments.

    

Technical education within maintenance, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

    

Basic computer skills and experience using maintenance software and documenting maintenance activities.

    

Ability to communicate technical information clearly.

    

Fluent English, both spoken and written.

    

Swedish is highly desirable.

The role is part of the Group Tax function and involves responsibility for global tax processes, with a particular focus on Pillar II reporting, as well as tax compliance, planning, and strategy for selected legal entities. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, external advisors, auditors, and tax authorities.

Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and coordinate the Group’s Pillar II reporting

    

Develop and implement global tax strategies to optimize the effective tax rate

    

Provide tax advice related to cross-border transactions, M&A, and restructurings

    

Identify tax optimization opportunities while ensuring alignment with business objectives

    

Manage direct tax filings and payments, ensuring timely compliance

    

Manage tax audits and inquiries from tax authorities

    

Review current and deferred tax calculations

    

Review tax provisions under local GAAP for selected legal entities

    

Monitor developments in local and international tax legislation and support implementation of relevant changes

    

Maintain robust internal controls to mitigate direct tax risks

    

Collaborate with external tax advisors and auditors to ensure accurate tax reporting

Your Background

We are looking for a tax professional with a strong combination of technical expertise, analytical ability, and business understanding. You should have:

    

A university degree in Law, Finance, or a related field

    

Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience within tax

    

Good understanding of finance processes and systems

    

Strong knowledge of international taxation, US tax legislation, and tax accounting standards

    

Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills

    

Strong business acumen and a high level of integrity

You are self-motivated, proactive, and solution-oriented, with the ability to identify improvements and take ownership of complex issues. You are also comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment and communicating effectively with multiple stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced tax professional who wants to take on a key role in global tax reporting, compliance, and strategic tax matters within a complex international organization.

title: Workforce Management Expert
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.

You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.

You will:

    Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
    Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
    Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
    Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
    Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
    Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
    Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
    Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
    Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
    Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
    Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
    Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.

We are looking for people with:

    Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
    Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
    Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
    Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
    Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
    Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
    Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
    Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

An example of our benefits:

    25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
    H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

The role

As Oceanbird moves from a prototype stage into commercial customer delivery, successful installation is becoming one of our most important capabilities.

As Installation Lead, you will turn plans and technical solutions into safe, efficient and wellcoordinated installations at shipyards and onboard vessels. You will also be responsible for our demonstrator wing in Landskrona, coordinating its operation, maintenance and test readiness so that it provides the data needed for our continued development.

You will be part of the Project Management Office and work closely with our project managers. During installations, you will lead a cross-functional team of approximately 3–8 people, including electricians, service engineers, technical specialists and external contractors.

The Project Manager retains overall responsibility for the customer project, while you lead the dayto-day installation activities and safe execution at the shipyard, in harbor or at sea.

Your main responsibilities:

• Plan, prepare and lead installation and commissioning activities at shipyards/harbour and onboard vessels.

• Translate project and engineering requirements into practical installation plans, work sequences, resource needs and schedules.

• Coordinate the on-site installation team and act as Oceanbird’s operational interface with shipyards, vessel crews, customers and subcontractors.

• Lead the safe execution of installation work, ensuring that risk assessments, work permits, toolbox talks and agreed safety procedures are in place and followed.

• Monitor progress, quality and safety, resolve practical issues and escalate risks or decisions when required.

• Develop and maintain installation procedures, method statements, SOPs, checklists and installation manuals.

• Capture lessons learned and use them to improve future installations, documentation and ways of working.

• Coordinate the operation, maintenance, inspection and test readiness of the demonstrator wing and its supporting equipment in Landskrona.

• Plan activities together with the Landskrona team and work closely with our teams in Flemingsberg to incorporate experience from installations and testing into our continued development.

Who are you?

You are a practical and confident installation leader who can bring people from different disciplines together, create structure and maintain focus on safety and delivery—even when conditions change.

You are likely to have:

• Experience leading installations, commissioning, service or major maintenance involving complex mechanical or electromechanical equipment.

Classified by Alfa Laval as: Business

• Experience from commercial vessels and shipyards, ideally involving bulk carriers, tankers or similar vessel types.

• Experience from newbuild projects and working closely with shipyards in Asia is highly valuable.

• A relevant engineering qualification within mechanical, marine, electrical or a related technical field. This could be a vocational, college or bachelor-level qualification, or equivalent experience.

• A strong understanding of safe working practices in shipyard, industrial or onboard environments.

• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, contractors and external stakeholders.

• The ability to produce clear and practical technical documentation, including SOPs and installation manuals.

• Professional proficiency in English and the willingness to travel internationally and work onboard vessels.

You are safety-conscious, structured and calm under pressure. You communicate clearly across technical disciplines and cultures and are comfortable moving between planning, documentation and hands-on execution.

Location and travel

We are open to discussing the location for the right candidate, although proximity to either Flemingsberg or Landskrona is preferred.

Regular international travel and periods of work at shipyards and onboard vessels are an integral part of the role.

What we offer

At Oceanbird, you will help turn a bold vision into working technology at sea. You will see the direct result of your work as our wing sail technology moves from development and testing to installation onboard commercial vessels—and ultimately into operation at sea.

This is an opportunity to shape not only how our first commercial installations are delivered, but how Oceanbird will install wing sails around the world in the future. Working alongside highly skilled and passionate colleagues, you will influence our installation methods, safety standards and ways of working—and contribute directly to making wind a powerful part of cleaner shipping.

Join us in redefining the future of clean shipping.

Apply today and be part of a journey that truly makes a difference!

We review applications continually so please send in your application as soon as possible.

We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

A businesspartner for growth and maintainance, www.briljantin.se

title: Senior Business Controller – Software & Tech
description:
Would you like to combine business controlling, financial analysis, and business-oriented advisory in an environment where software and advanced technology are at the core? 📊💻

We are looking for a Senior Business Controller for a long-term consulting assignment in Gothenburg. In this role, you will work closely with senior decision-makers, transforming financial data into insights, challenging assumptions, and contributing to well-informed business decisions.

You will work in a technology-intensive organization developing software for modern vehicles, including digital services, infotainment, and advanced driver assistance systems. 🚗

About the Role

As a Senior Business Controller, you will have broad responsibilities combining operational controlling, project and program follow-up, and business partnering. You will work closely with senior management and act as a proactive financial partner in both strategic and operational matters.

An important part of the role is creating transparency around costs, budgets, and forecasts. You will analyze financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that relevant decision-making data and insights are available.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    

Acting as a financial partner to senior management, providing clear analyses and recommendations.

    

Driving monthly financial follow-up, including variance analyses and performance reviews.

    

Working with OPEX, cost control, and monitoring financial KPIs.

    

Managing budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial planning for various programs and projects.

    

Monitoring project costs, burn rates, and forecast accuracy, and highlighting deviations.

    

Collaborating cross-functionally with engineering, procurement, program management, and other functions.

    

Reviewing purchase requests and supplier invoices to ensure compliance with budgets, contracts, and internal guidelines.

    

Driving recurring budgeting and forecasting processes.

    

Preparing financial analyses and presentations for senior management.

    

Proactively identifying financial risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 📈

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in controlling who thrives in a business-oriented role. You are analytical and structured, but above all, you have the ability to understand the business behind the numbers and translate your analysis into concrete recommendations.

You are comfortable working independently, challenging existing assumptions, and communicating financial matters to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

Ideally, you have:

    

A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or equivalent.

    

At least 3–5 years of experience in business controlling, financial controlling, business partnering, program controlling, or a similar role.

    

Solid experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.

    

Strong analytical skills and experience working with large volumes of financial data.

    

Experience working cross-functionally and closely with senior stakeholders.

    

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

    

Excellent spoken and written English.

Experience from automotive, technology, engineering, or another development-intensive environment is considered an advantage. Previous experience in project controlling, program controlling, or automotive development programs is also a plus.

Additional Merits

Experience with the following is considered an advantage:

    

Power Query / Excel Query and macros

    

Power BI

    

SAP S/4HANA

About the Assignment

📍 Location: Gothenburg, on-site 📅 Start date: September 1, 2026 ⏳ Assignment period: Until August 31, 2027 🕒 Scope: Full-time, 40 hours per week

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to take on a central financial role close to the business while working in an environment where finance meets software development and advanced technology.

title: Finance Manager to Öhlins Group
description:
Do you want to take on a key role in a world-leading technology company with one of Sweden’s strongest brands in motorsport and premium vehicles? Do you thrive at the intersection of operational accounting, group reporting, and leadership? Then the role as Finance Manager at Öhlins could be the next step in your career.

Öhlins is in an exciting phase where the focus on business performance, cash flow, and financial governance is greater than ever. We are now looking for a Finance Manager who wants to help develop the finance function in an international environment.

Your Challenge

As Finance Manager, you will have overall responsibility for accounting and financial reporting across the Group. This is a central role within the organization, involving close collaboration with the CFO, management team, and colleagues in our international subsidiaries. You will be responsible for ensuring high quality in accounting, financial closings, and reporting while leading a high-performing finance team. The role combines hands-on operational work with leadership responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence processes, ways of working, and the continued development of the finance function.

The position is based at the headquarters in Upplands Väsby and reports directly to the CFO.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for:

    Responsible for all accounting and reporting, including monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and external reports

    Ensure timely and accurate preparation of financial statements, reports and forecasts in accordance with GAAP and regulatory requirements

    Serve as the primary internal expert on Swedish GAAP (K3), statutory reporting and local regulatory requirements.

    Develop, structure and maintain accounting department procedures and internal controls

    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning

    Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making and strategic planning

    Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors and regulators

    Stay up to date on accounting standards, regulations and industry trends to ensure compliance and best practices

    Lead and develop the accounting team and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth

    Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to streamline workflows and increase efficiency.

Qualifications

We believe you have:

    A university degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field

    Approximately 7-10 years of experience in accounting and finance

    Experience managing or leading an accounting function

    Extensive knowledge of K3 accounting standards, annual reporting, and Swedish regulatory frameworks

    Demonstrated experience preparing annual reports for Swedish legal entities

    Experience with group accounting and consolidation

    Strong systems proficiency and an interest in efficient processes

    Experience from an international organization is considered an advantage

    Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken as communication and documentation take place in both languages

If you have a background in auditing, preferably with a Big Four firm, we consider that particularly interesting.

Personal Attributes

To succeed in this role, you are a confident and down-to-earth professional who enjoys collaboration and building long-term relationships. You are a natural team player who builds trust across the organization and works effectively both with your team and with other functions within the business. You are structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused, with strong analytical skills and sound business acumen. You are confident in your accounting expertise, able to balance attention to detail with a holistic perspective, and motivated by developing both people and processes to create sustainable improvements and results.

About Öhlins Group

Passion, Performance, Perfection — this is the Öhlins way. Our passion for innovation and state-of-the-art technology is the driving force in our search for the next generation of advanced suspension technology. Öhlins has been a cornerstone of the motorsport, motorcycle, and automotive industries for over 45 years. Since day one, our focus has been on delivering high-quality products, service, and support—from the MotoGP circuit to national and local racing events—in over 50 distributing countries. We supply the aftermarket, OEM partners, and teams with high-end suspension technology, and strive to exceed the expectations of our customers around the world.

Application

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). - Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutspital 80-100% für die Region Wetzikon gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wetzikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wetzikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Tagdienst 50-100% für die Region Lyss gesucht
description:
- Für ein renommiertes Pflegeheim in der Region Lyss suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – geregelter Tagdienst mit planbaren Arbeitszeiten.

### Ihr neuer Job als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Lyss im Überblick

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

**Pensum:** 50–100 % (flexibel wählbar)

**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung

**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Lyss

**Arbeitgeber:** Pflegeheim – den Namen erfahren Sie im Gespräch

Lyss liegt in der Region Seeland im Kanton Bern und besticht durch eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung via Bahnhof und Autobahn. Sie profitieren hier von kurzen Wegen zu größeren Städten wie Bern und Zürich. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Umfeld mit guter Infrastruktur, florierendem Gewerbe und hoher Lebensqualität, was Lyss zu einem beliebten Arbeitsort macht.

### Ihr Wirkungsfeld als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH im Tagdienst in Lyss

- Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Bedarfserhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Vorbereitung und Abgabe der Medikamente
- Überwachung von Vitalzeichen und frühzeitiges Erkennen von Zustandsveränderungen
- Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden im Team
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen Pflegesystem
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien und Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe
- Darüber hinaus Mitgestaltung von Pflegekonzepten sowie wir verbessern die Qualität stetig im Team
- Teilnahme an interprofessionellen Rapporten und Visiten im geregelten Tagdienst

### Damit überzeugen Sie uns

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Empathie und Belastbarkeit
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

Diese Stelle ist im Tagdienst angelegt. Sie arbeiten also in einer klaren Tagesstruktur mit geregelten Übergaben am Morgen und am Abend. Dabei nehmen Sie an Rapporten im Team mit Ärzten und Therapien teil, koordinieren Termine mit Ärzten und Therapeuten und begleiten Angehörigengespräche. Somit verbinden Sie fachliche Verantwortung mit einem planbaren Alltag.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann HF/FH im Tagdienst verbinden Sie fachliche Tiefe mit einem Alltag, der Planung zulässt. Genau deshalb ist die Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH im Tagdienst in Lyss bei Berufsleuten mit Familie so beliebt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben zum Beispiel den Pflegebedarf, planen anschliessend die Massnahmen, führen sie durch und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern sie die Medikamentenabgabe, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen im Gesundheitszustand frühzeitig. So entsteht Pflegequalität, die bei jeder Bewohnerin und jedem Bewohner ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die dreijährige höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium in Pflege an einer Fachhochschule (FH). Beide Abschlüsse berechtigen zur eigenverantwortlichen Berufsausübung. Ausländische Diplome benötigen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen attraktive Weiterbildungen offen, etwa ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Funktion als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt in der Region Lyss zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen, wobei Teilzeitpositionen im Tagdienst besonders gefragt sind. Sie profitieren als Fachkraft von exzellenten Karrierechancen und attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen bei verschiedenen Arbeitgebern. iPersonal unterstützt Sie durch spezialisierte Vermittlung, umfassende Beratung und direkte Kontakte zu etablierten Gesundheitseinrichtungen, wodurch Ihr Einstieg oder Stellenwechsel deutlich vereinfacht wird.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Lyss

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – so wächst Ihre Karriere weiter
- Dazu persönliche Beratung durch Ihre feste Ansprechperson, von der Bewerbung bis zum Stellenantritt
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
